issues.description: findChangedFiles returning null silently disables filtering and reports coverage for all files
issues.detail: When VitestGit.findChangedFiles returns null (not a git repo, bad ref, etc.), onTestRunStart sets changedFiles to undefined and coverage silently falls through to report everything. A user who asked for changed-only coverage gets the opposite. Warn or throw rather than degrading silently.

issues.description: globCache key is just filename but cached value now depends on changedFiles state
issues.detail: The cache stores 'included' keyed only by filename, but the answer now depends on changedFiles. Clearing the cache inside onTestRunStart papers over this, but any caller invoking isIncluded before that hook fires poisons the cache. Either key on (filename, changedFiles identity) or separate the pure glob match from the changed-file filter applied after.

issues.description: changedFiles comparison uses raw string equality on paths with no normalization invariant
issues.detail: isIncluded compares slash(cleanUrl(filename)) against this.changedFiles.includes(filename), but findChangedFiles returns whatever git produced. Mismatched absolute/relative paths or Windows separators silently filter everything out. No precondition is stated or asserted, and no Windows test exercises this path.

issues.description: onTestRunStart hook duplicated across three call sites in core.ts with no enforced invariant
issues.detail: core.ts now hand-pastes `await this.coverageProvider?.onTestRunStart?.()` after _testRun.start(...) in three places. The ordering invariant is convention-only; the next code path added will forget it. Fold into _testRun.start or a helper, or resolve changedFiles once when the run object is constructed and pass it as a value.

issues.description: CLI transform handles boolean inputs that the CLI parser never produces
issues.detail: The transform checks `value === true || value === false`, but CLI args arrive as strings. These dead branches suggest unclear preconditions on `value`. Either document why programmatic config reaches this path, or delete the boolean checks. Handling unreachable cases invites future bugs.

issues.description: Test file mode accidentally flipped from 644 to 755
issues.detail: test/coverage-test/test/changed.test.ts changes from old mode 100644 to new mode 100755. A .ts test file is not executable. Accidental chmod clutters the diff and confuses maintainers. Revert the mode bit.

synthesis.summary: The panel converges strongly: the feature's intent is sound but the changed-files plumbing is under-specified and fragile. Three independent reviewers flagged the same correctness triad — silent fallthrough when findChangedFiles returns null, a globCache whose key no longer captures all inputs to its value, and path-equality comparisons with no normalization invariant (especially on Windows). Secondary concerns cluster around incidental complexity: the onTestRunStart hook is hand-pasted at three call sites in core.ts instead of being folded into start, and the CLI transform handles boolean branches the parser never produces. Verdict: NEEDS-WORK — tighten path normalization, fail loud on null git results, key or split the cache, and consolidate the lifecycle hook.
